overview.oneLineTake: Records on narrowing breadth with yields at 24-year highs and minutes Wednesday is a tape to stay hedged in, not one to sell cheap downside into.
themes: Stocks and yields both up: Nasdaq 100 set another record Monday (QQQ +0.9% to 756.20, SPY +0.7% to 774.83) on Nvidia, Microsoft and AI deal flow, but breadth narrowed and the Dow lagged.

Long-end rout keeps grinding: the 10-year rose about 4bp to ~5.31%, long bonds hit multi-decade highs, and BMO talks of a 6% long bond. French bond stress is weighing on the euro and the dollar is near its 2026 high.
Oil eased as Hormuz flows recover (WTI -2.1% to ~$89, Aramco cut Asian prices), but the Saudi-Houthi war is widening and the U.S. Iran blockade is still turning ships away.
Fed hike pricing is live: about 23% for October and a full 25bp by December. Services PMI cooled with prices building, and FOMC minutes land Wednesday.
AI financing is stretching: OpenAI eyeing a ~$1.4T round, a record $60B Broadcom/Anthropic chip loan, EA bondholders alleging default, and the NY Fed probing bank loans to private credit.
risks: 10-year pushing toward new highs above 5.3% while equity leadership narrows sets up a rates-driven de-rating.
Red Sea and Gulf escalation (Riyadh and Aramco targeted) could reverse the oil dip fast.
Hawkish minutes pull hike odds forward and hit crowded AI and chip longs.

nq.summary: NDX printed another record on NVDA, MSFT and AI deal flow while the 10Y tagged a 24-year high near 5.35%. Stocks and yields rising together is holding for now, but breadth narrowed and VXN rose with price. Trend stays up until rates or the minutes say otherwise. Thesis: mildly bullish, 5/10 (brief rated Low-Med), buy dips in trend. Invalidation: NDX close below 30,800. NDX levels: resistance 31,117 (record high), 31,250, 31,500; support 31,018, 30,800, 30,616.
nq.primaryCatalyst: Fed's Bowman at 9:45 PM BKK, then FOMC minutes Thursday 1:00 AM BKK.
nq.primaryRisk: 10Y through 5.35%, Red Sea escalation, or hawkish FOMC minutes.
nq.overnight: NQ firm and quiet in a 31,326-31,385 band. Oil eased (WTI ~$89, Brent ~$100) after Aramco cut Asia prices.
nq.macro: 30Y hit ~5.70%. Markets price ~23% for an October hike and a full 25bp by December. Every new yield high is a direct de-rating risk for long-duration tech.
nq.volatility: VIX 15.5 (+1.4%), VXN 21.7 (+2.4%). Vol bid into a record is a hedging tell. Dealer gamma unavailable.
